# leaderboard — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Leaderboard (top traders ranked by PnL, win rate, or volume). Required flags are in the signature; `ocl leaderboard <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### leaderboard supported-chains
Get supported chains for the leaderboard
`ocl leaderboard supported-chains`

### leaderboard list
Get leaderboard list (top traders ranked by PnL, win rate, or volume)
`ocl leaderboard list --chain <CHAIN> --time-frame <TIME_FRAME> --sort-by <SORT_BY> [options]`
- `--wallet-type <WALLET_TYPE>` — Wallet type filter (single select): sniper, dev, fresh, pump, smartMoney, influencer
- `--min-realized-pnl-usd <MIN_REALIZED_PNL_USD>` — Minimum realized PnL in USD
- `--max-realized-pnl-usd <MAX_REALIZED_PNL_USD>` — Maximum realized PnL in USD
- `--min-win-rate-percent <MIN_WIN_RATE_PERCENT>` — Minimum win rate percentage (0-100)
- `--max-win-rate-percent <MAX_WIN_RATE_PERCENT>` — Maximum win rate percentage (0-100)
- `--min-txs <MIN_TXS>` — Minimum number of transactions
- `--max-txs <MAX_TXS>` — Maximum number of transactions
- `--min-tx-volume <MIN_TX_VOLUME>` — Minimum transaction volume in USD
- `--max-tx-volume <MAX_TX_VOLUME>` — Maximum transaction volume in USD
